question: Does fixed task qualification improve predicted-task/audited-route joint yield versus source-relative qualification on independently generated optimizer runs?

source_generator.objective: Fixed task RF probability only; invalid/disconnected inputs score zero. No constant feedback, quality multiplier, route or Chemprop score.
source_generator.initialization: Independent seeded uniform permutation of corpus rows; accept first 100 valid connected unique canonical structures, without task/QED/route filtering. Record rejected selected rows and corpus positions.
source_generator.terminal_output: 64 independent uniform draws with replacement from the complete ordered terminal population of 100. Separate saved sampling seed; retain duplicates. No top-k64 export or post-export filtering.
source_generator.proposal_accounting: All 25,000 attempted offspring per optimizer run are retained in existing lineage files. Terminal draws are not described as raw mutation proposals.
source_generator.runtime: Original RF environment Python 3.11.15 / sklearn 1.2.2 / RDKit 2023.09.6.

method.trigger: Joint guiding-RF qualification and audited parent-route failure
method.qualification: Strict candidate RF >=max(source RF, task cutoff); fixed RF >=task cutoff; same source QED-.05, source/stock exclusions, original two-stock dual formation, RF/QED/SMILES descending selection.
method.stock: same PaRoutes N1 stock and standard InChIKey derivation
method.templates: same retained SynTwins forward/retro template tables
method.route_audit: Saved native graph reload, route extraction, stock leaves and target exclusion.

primary_contrast: B_fixedtask6plus6 minus B_joint6plus6, ten-checkpoint mean intended-task probability >=0.5 AND audited route; no guiding RF conjunct
statistics: 16 independent optimizer runs, 8 per fixed task, paired within-run raw yields; task-equal mean primary, Welch-Satterthwaite 95% interval/test; prespecified within-task run bootstrap100000 seed2026101801 sensitivity. Secondary contrasts exploratory, no molecular pseudoreplication; technical unknown bounds retained.
external_evaluation: Existing released ten two-task Chemprop checkpoints, only after final selection. Shared ExCAPE source and incomplete original training composition remain limitations.
historical_reuse: Named compatible completed formal512, oldGraphGA512, fixed128/512, allocation128, retained128 scores/forward/query/vector observations only; preserve actual origin and earliest exact records, including negatives. No old cohort generation repeated.
history_limits: Old8 GraphGA development results excluded from new primary statistical sample; reported independently. Original main-paper and old-prospective primaries unchanged.
enrollment: All16 specified runs/1024 retained draws; no outcome-driven extension, dropping task, checkpoint/threshold tuning, seed selection or unseen retries after an unobserved interruption.
publication: Private experiment. No public upload or manuscript revision during execution.
